def transform(grid):
    # The puzzle canvas is the solid color-1 rectangle; the isolated exterior
    # pixels are distractor markers. Reflect the entire canvas across its
    # anti-diagonal, yielding swapped dimensions.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    h, w = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
    out = [[0 for _ in range(h)] for _ in range(w)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            out[w-1-c][h-1-r] = grid[r0+r][c0+c]
    return out
PY
